case_scope: United States beneficial ownership registry implementation and domestic entity exemption subsystem case

beneficial_ownership_scope_stability.note: Domestic reporting companies and U.S. persons are exempt under the interim rule. rev0346 adds FinCEN IFR Q&A because the exemption is not only domestic-company coverage: reporting companies also do not report BOI of U.S. persons.

domestic_entity_reporting_coverage.note: The U.S. registry no longer covers entities created in the United States under the current FinCEN rule posture. FinCEN Q&A confirms domestic entities and their beneficial owners are exempt from initial, updated, and corrected BOI reports under the interim rule posture.

legal_attack_surface.note: Federal Register rule explicitly responds to litigation and deadline pressures.

beneficial_ownership_verification.note: Verification and alternative rails need reassessment after narrowed coverage. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: Targeted transparency analysis is now bound as context for BOI verification and access design.

map state-level and sectoral BO disclosure substitutes
test tax/procurement/property authority access to domestic controller data
